items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: JB, that's the kid I went to school with.

ctx.x: Did it have a special meaning to you, the Billy goat?

Oh, I wanted a goat because the goat was popular. I had friends that had goats, you know, and I got a goat. Then I wanted to do the last day of school performances of the show they have on, I wanted my father to make me a carrier-van and have a Billy goat and do Indian and cowboy stories, which I put on at the school, you know. And that was my popularity and I wanted to have that movement

in the school. Then I wanted to be at the head of the class in singing. I wanted to be at the head of the class in drawing, manual training, all this, / I wanted to be at the head of the class, so I worked hard at that and worked hard at that. So finally -- we were coming home from school and all the kids had to pass by a white school on North Street and at this white school all the kids was throwing rocks at the colored kids. Well, I didn't understand why. So one day I told my mother about this. And she said,…
